body.name: selectedbeta
body.construction: For every sample and \(j\in\mathcal J\), continuity of the total objective on the compact ball makes \(\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{\beta\in\mathcal B_n}F_{jn}(\beta)\) nonempty and compact. Define \(\widehat\beta_{jn}\) by first minimizing \(\|\beta\|_2\) over that set and then successively minimizing coordinates \(1,\ldots,p_n\); this deterministic lexicographic rule returns exactly one global maximizer
